notes: Vertex's implemented Gemini language, tuned endpoint, embedding, Gemini TTS speech, Cloud Speech-to-Text transcription, Veo video, and Interactions surface was audited against upstream Google Vertex 5.0.140. The native embedding limits remain: 250 inputs for standard models and one input for Gemini multimodal embeddings. Imagen image generation/editing factories remain locally available for source compatibility after their removal from the current upstream package. Shared Gemini request behavior includes local JSON Schema `$ref` expansion with boolean-schema references, the Gemini 3.7 Flash `low` thinking floor, forward-compatible future-model capabilities, and response IDs; standard Vertex function-call and function-response IDs are omitted while server-tool IDs remain intact. Video supports first/last frame images, reference images, and top-level generateAudio precedence. Speech routes `chirp*` model IDs to authenticated Cloud TTS `text:synthesize` with Chirp voice/language defaults, LINEAR16/WAV handling, speed mapping, warnings, and metadata; other IDs keep Gemini TTS generateContent with WAV-wrapped PCM by default, raw PCM opt-in, multi-speaker provider options, sample-rate metadata, and upstream warnings. Vertex Batch and remaining broader shared Google language/safety/usage/request gaps retain their documented scope. Native Vertex Gemini unary and Live transcription are available. Node google-auth-library options, workflow serialization, ProviderV4 type names, and ESM-only packaging remain JS-runtime/package-surface concerns. The 5.0.76 pass adds an exact Maverick/Scout MaaS default of `max_tokens: 8192` without overwriting caller values and inherits the audited Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI-compatible shared behavior. The 2026-09-27 pass adds `gs://` tool-result media and the shared current TTS behavior. The 2026-10-04 pass validates generated location/Chirp region hosts, reports Gemini image capabilities, and retains speech usageMetadata; Vertex Gemini transcription was deferred at that snapshot and is implemented in the 2026-11-08 pass. The 2026-10-11 pass inherits JSON-with-tools conversion and shared embedding dimensions; native Gemini transcription was a gap at that snapshot and is implemented in the 2026-11-08 pass. The 2026-10-18 pass: Inherited GenerateContent continuation/usage/AUDIO/thinking and background Interactions behavior is current. Vertex Anthropic labels are covered by its separate adapter. The 2026-11-01 reviewed delta adds native per-request async credentials and current portable request/stream fixes where applicable; see WeeklyUpstreamAudit20261101 for exact package dispositions and retained gaps. The 2026-11-08 reviewed delta and retained gaps are documented in WeeklyUpstreamAudit20261108; no full-package or live-service parity is implied.
